signature.one_line: B-roll course ad: one shot and one accent key word per module, lead words justified above.
unique_devices: Justified lockup: small white lead words stretched to exactly the width of one big accent #F2D805 key word below them, at 62-70 % H over a dark bottom gradient
One-shot-per-item syllabus montage: each spoken module gets its own ~50-70 frame B-roll shot + its key word (26-43 cuts/min)
Top-flipped variant once for the big claim (key phrase at 19 % H, small words under it) with a falling-banknote overlay
Ad-style CTA stack: white serif 'CONTACT US:' + accent serif phone number, then a black end card with accent logo and tan label boxes
signature.why_it_works: Viewers read the module list without full captions; constant shot changes plus one bold word per sentence make a long ad feel brisk.

top-variant key phrase + money-rain overlay, then a 3-line accent bullet list of benefits

hands-on workshops and content-creation class as value proof

two accent lines, line 1 right-aligned to line 2, 61-73 % H

slow push-in on screen footage with soft swaps

captions_spec.punctuation: none in callouts (apostrophes kept in contractions); colon after the CTA heading
captions_spec.emoji: none (a falling-banknote overlay is used once, ~7-10 % of runtime)

grouping.key_words_per_caption: 1-2 (the topic noun phrase of the sentence: the module, skill or claim word)
grouping.sync: word by word: each lead word, then the key word, appears as it is spoken
grouping.break: one callout per sentence; many B-roll shots have no callout

layout.lockup: the white lead line sits directly above the key word and is JUSTIFIED to the key word's width: first lead word flush with the key's left edge, last lead word flush with its right edge, extra space between words (a 3-word lead over a 10-letter key spans x 18.5-84 %)
layout.top_variant: once (the big-claim sentence, ~3-10 % of runtime) the lockup flips to the top: a 2-word key phrase centre y 19.4 % spanning x 7.2-94.3 %, with the small white words UNDER it at 24.6 %, first word flush left (x 7.6 %) and last word flush right
layout.stack_variant: two-word key phrases can stack as two yellow lines, line 1 right-aligned to line 2 (61-73 % H)
layout.background: dark bottom gradient (black -> transparent, from the bottom edge to ~55 %) behind the lower callouts

lead.font_class: geometric sans, bold (Montserrat-like: two-storey a, round o, angled t)

calibration.note: (estimated): height-based 50 px vs width-based 66 px differ ~30 %, the j dot/descender was probably clipped; trust the width

lead.word_spacing: stretched to justify the line to the key word's width
lead.k_note: a 3-letter b+g lead word measured 2.58 % H -> ~50 px

key.size_note: roughly fixed size (~125-129 px), not fit-to-width: a 10-letter key word measured ink 5.16 % H / 65.1 % W; a 2-word 13-letter phrase runs to ~87 % W (6.72 % H incl. descender)

cta.font_class: bold high-contrast serif caps (display serif) for the contact line

closest_match.web_font: Playfair Display Bold (alt DM Serif Display)

second_line.text: phone number(s) in the same serif, yellow #F2D805, ink 2.5 % H, 77.4 % W, centre y 69.8 %

animation.entry: each word fades in with a blur and a slight scale-down / upward settle over ~3-4 frames (blurred on frame 1, sharp by frame 3-4)
animation.timing: word by word in speech rhythm (lead words ~2-5 frames apart, key word last); judge sync from picture if the transcript timing drifts
animation.exit: hard cut with the shot change (callouts live inside their shot); some first frames of a new shot carry a light-leak flash

other_text_spec.text: 3 left-aligned yellow #F2D805 lines with yellow ring bullets (3 short benefit lines, placeholder 'Lead words here' x3), bold geometric, line ink ~3.6 % H (~94 px), baseline pitch 5.5 % H, block x 12.8-89 %, y 62-76 %, over the dark bottom gradient

other_text_spec.when: ~14 % of runtime (when the brand is first named)
other_text_spec.text: circular brand logo badge pops in (scale-in ~15 frames) at ~70 % height (estimated)
one-line offer statement ('Headline here') in small yellow bold, ~65 % H (estimated)

other_text_spec.when: ~7-10 % of runtime (~75 frames) on the money / revenue line
other_text_spec.text: falling banknotes over the top-variant callout
'CONTACT US:' white bold serif caps centre y 65.6 % (ink 2.66 % H, 39.6 % W) + phone number(s) in yellow serif centre y 69.8 % (77.4 % W)

gold-gradient logo mark + brand name at 28-42 %; tan box #CF9C5E with white caps descriptor lines at 45-50 %; 'contact' and 'location' headings in tan #B18B63 caps with white caps details below (54-71 %), neo-grotesque caps

style.look_intent: warm, saturated, golden venue light; high-contrast, natural saturation, dark bottom vignette/gradient for text

sound.music: music bed likely (heuristic) under continuous VO; upbeat corporate / motivational bed
sfx: cash / whoosh on the money-rain overlay (inferred)
cuts rarely land on beats (measured cut_hit_share 0.05)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: a course, institute, agency or service ad built mostly from B-roll with a voice-over

brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B30 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B30.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship — text and accent must stay >= 4.5:1 / >= 3:1 against what sits behind them on the footage):
- {{TEXT}}      default #FFFFFF (lead words, CTA heading)
- {{ACCENT}}    default #F2D805 (key words, bullets, phone number)
- {{ACCENT_2}}  default #CF9C5E (end-card descriptor box)
- {{SURFACE}}   default #000000 (end card / bottom gradient)
- {{CARD_BG}}   default #B18B63 (end-card headings)
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} default Poppins 700 (Montserrat ExtraBold is closer)
- {{FONT_BODY}}    default Poppins 700; Playfair Display 700 for the CTA heading
- {{HANDLE}}    default @handle
- {{LOGO}}      default the brand's logo file (transparent PNG/SVG)
{{ACCENT}} must stay >= 3:1 on the footage even above the gradient; a dark brand colour needs a lighter tint for the key words.
Canvas 1080x1920, 30 fps.

CAPTIONS (keyword callouts, not full transcripts)
1. One callout per sentence, only on shots where the sentence has a clear topic phrase: 1-3 small lowercase lead-in words as spoken + ONE key word or 2-word phrase in Title Case (placeholder 'lead words here' + 'KEY WORD'). No punctuation, no emoji.
2. Key: {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 128 px (fixed size, never fit-to-width; a 2-word phrase may run to ~87 % W), {{ACCENT}}, tracking -0.01 em, slight dark shadow 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.4), no stroke / box, centred at ~68 % H. Two-word phrases may stack as two lines, line 1 right-aligned to line 2.
3. Lead-in: {{FONT_DISPLAY}} at 57 px, {{TEXT}}, slight shadow, directly above the key word and JUSTIFIED to the key's width (first word flush left, last flush right, extra word spacing), centre ~62.3 % H.
4. Top variant (once, for the big claim): key phrase at the top (centre 19.4 %), small {{TEXT}} words UNDER it at 24.6 %, first flush left, last flush right.
5. Background: dark bottom gradient ({{SURFACE}} -> transparent from the bottom edge to ~55 % H) under the lower callouts.
6. Animation: each word appears as it is spoken — fade + blur + slight scale-down / upward settle over 3-4 frames; lead words first, key word last. Callouts hard-cut out with their shot. No idle motion.

OTHER TEXT (only where the script has a matching beat)
7. Bullet list (3 benefits): left-aligned {{ACCENT}} lines with ring bullets, bold geometric ~94 px, baseline pitch 5.5 % H, block x 12.8-89 %, y 62-76 %.
8. {{LOGO}} badge pop (~15-frame scale-in) at ~70 % H when the brand is first named; optional money-rain overlay (~75 frames) on a revenue / earnings line.
9. CTA: 'CONTACT US:' in {{TEXT}} bold serif caps (Playfair Display 700, 64 px, +0.02 em) centred at 65.6 %, phone number(s) in {{ACCENT}} serif below at 69.8 % (~77 % W).
10. End card (last ~114 frames): {{SURFACE}}; {{LOGO}} + brand name at 28-42 %; {{ACCENT_2}} box with white caps descriptor lines at 45-50 %; 'contact' / 'location' headings in {{CARD_BG}} caps with white caps details below (54-71 %).
11. Edit: B-roll for ~96 % of runtime, median ~73 frames per shot; in list sections one 50-70 frame shot per item; VO leads cuts (J-cuts); two light-leak flashes in the hook; screen footage gets slow push-ins. Limit the master to -1 dBTP.

GRADE
Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: warm, saturated, golden light, high contrast, dark bottom vignette for text.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render the lead word 'just' (in a lead line 'lead just here') over 'KEY WORD', and 'CONTACT US:', then measure:
   python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.12,0.655,0.88,0.71 --ink "{{ACCENT}}:60"
   python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.42,0.6,0.56,0.655 --ink "{{TEXT}}:40"
   python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.2,0.63,0.8,0.68 --ink "{{TEXT}}:50"
   Expected (±0.5 % H, ±2 % W): 'just' ~2.8 % H (estimated) / 11.7 % W; 'CONTACT US:' 2.66 % H / 39.6 % W at 64 px Playfair 700.
b) Key word: python3 video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "Poppins 700" --word "<Key word without descenders>" --ink 5.16 --tracking -0.01 -> ~122-128 px with Poppins (128 px is the width-balanced value; Montserrat ExtraBold matches better). Lead words: --font "Poppins 700" --word "just" --width 11.7 -> ~57-66 px. Measure white over a dark area. (fit_font.py needs a target: --ink and/or --width; it returns the px that reproduces that ink for YOUR word plus the width it will read at that px. Requires Pillow.)
c) Positions within ±1 % H: lead centre 62.3 %, key centre 68 %, top-variant key 19.4 %, CTA heading 65.6 %, number line 69.8 %.
